scratch.c_flags: -nodefaults -proc gekko -align powerpc -enum int -fp hardware -Cpp_exceptions off -O4,p -inline auto -pragma "cats off" -pragma "warn_notinlined off" -maxerrors 1 -nosyspath -RTTI off -fp_contract on -str reuse -multibyte -DVERSION_GEDE01 -DNDEBUG=1 -lang=c

compiler_build_rule:
game (linked False)
build build/GEDE01/src/game/game_fn_800F623C.o: mwcc_sjis $
    src/game/game_fn_800F623C.c | compilers/$mw_version/mwcceppc.exe $
    tools/mwcc_wrapper.py build/tools/sjiswrap.exe tools/transform_dep.py $
    || pre-compile
  mw_version = GC/1.3
  cflags = -nodefaults -proc gekko -align powerpc -enum int -fp hardware $
      -Cpp_exceptions off -O4,p -inline auto -pragma "cats off" -pragma $
      "warn_notinlined off" -maxerrors 1 -nosyspath -RTTI off -fp_contract $
      on -str reuse -multibyte -i include -i build/GEDE01/include $
      -DVERSION_GEDE01 -DNDEBUG=1 -lang=c
  basedir = build/GEDE01/src/game
  basefile = build/GEDE01/src/game/game_fn_800F623C
